Verify if the results include a structured timeline of cabinet durations, including Giorgia Meloni’s government. 3. If no direct timeline is found, cross-check with the **European Parliament’s official records** ([europarl.europa.eu](https://www.europarl.europa.eu)) for Italian government formation dates, as they often reference national statistical sources. 4. Confirm whether the extracted data meets the evidence standard by checking for: - A clear start/end date for Meloni’s cabinet. - Comparison with pre-war government durations for context. - Citation of ISTAT or another reputable source in the records.
